candidates.title: Prepare inventory-based restock notices

demandEvidence.chore: A Shopify-compatible app would let customers sign up for restock notices and send email notifications based on available inventory.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Is there a Shopify-compatible app that allows my customers to sign up for re-stock notifications, and allows us to send out re-stock email notifications to my customers, but only based on available

ease.reason: A beginner can mock inventory and signup rows, but no supplied implementation reference supports Shopify integration or email delivery.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small online shops may pay for restock notification setup; this request proves neither a paying buyer nor willingness to pay.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test can match fictional inventory to signup rows and prepare a notice; live store access and delivery remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A mock can repeat the matching step, while a person must verify stock accuracy and approve any real customer email.

evidence.reason: The request explicitly asks for signup and inventory-based restock emails, but gives no frequency, rules, corroboration or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: The concrete request supports a fictional-data matching and draft-notice experiment, but the proposed online-shop customer duplicates recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6; the provisional mean is also below threshold.
